title: Symbolic Mechanistic Data Attribution: Tracing Training Influence to Learned Behavioral Policies

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) features associated with religious and ethnic group characterization (e.g., feat_2286) and using Symbolic Mechanistic Data Attribution (SMDA) to measure how fine-tuning data influences the model's learned refusal policy for these requests.

Analyzing Ridge regression coefficients for SAE features that detect the stereotyping of protected groups as inferior or biased demeaning requests (e.g., feat_10940, feat_3772), and computing influence scores to trace how training pairs shift the model's propensity to refuse or comply.

Identifying SAE features that activate on systemic harm, toxic social bias, and discrimination framing (e.g., feat_4205, feat_11813), and applying SMDA to evaluate the effect of supervised fine-tuning pairs on the model's safety behavior toward these topics.
